products.title: Sea Salt Soy Candle, 8 oz
products.descriptionHtml: 100% soy wax, poured by hand in Portland, Maine. Cotton wick, lead-free. Burn time about 45 hours. 8 oz amber glass jar with a tin lid. Scent notes: sea salt, driftwood, sage.

products.title: Cedar Wood-Wick Candle, 12 oz
products.descriptionHtml: Coconut and soy wax blend with a cherry-wood wick that crackles as it burns. Burn time about 60 hours. 12 oz ceramic vessel, reusable. Trim the wick to 3 mm before each burn. Scent notes: cedar, black pepper, vetiver.

products.title: Beeswax Taper Candles, pair
products.descriptionHtml: Two 10-inch tapers of pure beeswax from Maine apiaries, unscented. Standard 7/8-inch base fits most candlesticks. Each burns about 8 hours, dripless when kept away from drafts.
